mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 10.0%, it signals a severe labor market contraction that triggers a policy response and reduces corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 10.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payroll employment signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-pandemic recovery regime, a sustained increase in housing starts above 1200 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and rising disposable income, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or the Rank IC for the condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressure that may trigger a monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL (YoY) > 3.0, or the Rank IC for the condition is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and an increase in the federal funds rate signals a contractionary monetary policy during a supply shock, which reduces corporate output and profits, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC for the condition is negative.
